parse.title: Virtual Samurai (Bachelor)
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 16.5 - JoJo Part 4 Update

Overview

Virtual Samurai (Bachelor) is a ​MythicalMythical​ Limited unit. He can only be obtained by evolving Virtual Samurai​.

Evolving

Virtual Samurai (Bachelor) can be evolved from Virtual Samurai with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Virtual Samurai
x4 Ice Crystallite
x4 Dark Crystallite
x2 Blood Crystallite
x4 Star Fruit
x1 Star Fruit (Blue)
x1 Star Fruit (Red)
x1 Star Fruit (Pink)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
